truth.governance_relation: initializer guard keys on ERC1967 _getImplementation() read from the contract's own storage; on the bare logic contract that slot is empty, so anyone can call initialize directly on the implementation and install their own guardian set (governance seat takeover of the logic contract)

with self-installed guardians the attacker signs a ContractUpgrade VAA; submitContractUpgrade -> upgradeImplementation delegatecalls initialize() on an attacker-chosen contract which can SELFDESTRUCT the shared logic, bricking the proxy and freezing ~$736M of bridged assets
